column1: # Census table for cargo — names the guard's typosquat lane flags (block or warn tier) that the registry shows are long-standing and heavily used.
# GENERATED by core/tools/established-table-gen — do not hand-edit; regenerate with:
#   go run ./tools/established-table-gen -ecosystem cargo -cache <dir outside the repo> -out cli/seeds/established_cargo.tsv
# Universe: the registry's full public name list (359202 names); the guard's detector flags 3852 of them (medium or high). No customer data.

# Admission (either line): first published >= 2 years before 2026-10-22 AND >= 100000 downloads/week, or >= 5 years AND >= 1000 downloads/week (20000 for a block-tier lookalike) (crates.io 90-day recent downloads x 7/90).
# Never admitted: known-malicious feed names (the `chainsaw guard update` OSV set + embedded floor), npm security placeholders, names without registry data, the reviewed keep-blocked list.
# Columns: name <TAB> weekly_downloads <TAB> version_count <TAB> first_published <TAB> last_published <TAB> releases (comma-separated, build-time).
# The guard is silent only for an exact pin in releases; any other install of a row warns. Rows: 207.
